summary: Retest of the 2 targeted fixes from iteration_3. Both fixes VERIFIED via Playwright against the live preview URL. (1) StepParsing auto-advance on FAILURE: uploaded a broken/non-PDF, backend returned HTTP 400 as expected, red parsing-error text 'Could not read PDF: Stream has ended unexpectedly' rendered, and the flow AUTO-ADVANCED from Step 3 -> Step 4 within ~14s (typewriter ~11s + 2s fallback + 0.9s exit). User no longer stuck. (2) PhoneInput: switched from isValidPhoneNumber -> isPossiblePhoneNumber. IN 10-digit '9876543210' enables Continue; switching country to US with same 10 digits KEEPS Continue enabled (previously blocked because 987 is not an assigned NANP area code). US 5-digit disabled; US 10-digit enabled; letters typed via keyboard are blocked (input stays empty). Regression pass: red asterisk element present (data-testid=resume-required-asterisk), no 'Mandatory' word on Step 2, + Add renders LEFT of Upload on certifications row (Add x=691, Upload x=761), multi-cert add (2) and remove (1) works, typewriter progressive lines render, framer-motion transitions active, Step 4 reached on both success and failure paths. Backend regression: pytest 4/4 pass on /app/backend/tests/test_resume_parse.py.
critical_code_review_comments: StepParsing effect now correctly advances on `typewriterDone && parsingReady` without the parsingError guard — fix confirmed. Combined with the 2s setParsingReady(true) fallback in kickOffParsing, both success and failure paths advance deterministically.

useCountryPhone now uses isPossiblePhoneNumber (length-based) — matches product intent of 'mathematically valid digit count for that country' and eliminates the surprise disable on country switch. Correct choice for onboarding UX.
Minor (not blocking): kickOffParsing dependency array is [resumeFile] but the fn references API/toast — fine since those are stable. No action.
Minor: on parse failure the red error text remains visible on Step 3 for the last ~0.9s before exit — acceptable UX; a toast also fires. No change needed.
seed_data_creation: In-container /tmp/broken.pdf (garbage bytes) to force backend 400; /tmp/cert1.png & /tmp/cert2.png for multi-cert list test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both iteration_3 defects resolved and verified end-to-end. Backend /api/onboarding/parse-resume unchanged and green. Frontend Onboarding.jsx StepParsing effect drops !parsingError guard (line ~384). PhoneInput.jsx uses isPossiblePhoneNumber. Playwright ran against preview URL from frontend/.env. No open issues.
rca of the issue: Iteration_3 issues both root-caused correctly and fixed as recommended: (a) removed the `!parsingError` guard so the 2s parsingReady fallback triggers onComplete; (b) switched libphonenumber-js API to isPossiblePhoneNumber to accept any digit-length-valid number regardless of area-code assignment.
